note: Issue 4 (Android app load-error page): Capacitor shows capacitor/www/index.html for any main-frame load that fails at the network level OR answers HTTP >= 400, without saying which. The page now gathers evidence (navigator.onLine, a no-cors probe of the server's /api/health and of Android's connectivity check) and only names a cause it has evidence for; otherwise it shows a careful message. It never navigates by itself; retry / back / home work with or without history.

lib/native/android-error-page.test.ts.notSecurityBecause: a static, bundled error page of the Android shell; no data, auth, session or permission path (probes send no cookie and no referrer)
lib/native/android-error-page.test.ts.reason: pure: runs the page's own script in a vm — the verdict table (page / server / offline / unknown; a specific claim only with evidence; onLine=true proves nothing), the copy per verdict and the careful initial message, the server origin (Capacitor's injected value, local origin and odd values fall back to Production), the probe (any opaque answer = reachable; reject / throw / timeout = not; no-cors, no cookie, no referrer, cache-busted), the page end to end for 404/500, server down, offline, unknown, the 'online' re-check (words only, never navigation, one probe pair at a time), and retry / back / home with 3, 2 and 1 history entries (never reload); premises in the installed Capacitor 8.5 (both error hooks, main frame only; WEBVIEW_SERVER_URL is the server origin; errorPath still points here)
